propositions: Provider construction logic is currently scattered across runner.py with inline if-branches for each provider, creating code smell and blocking new provider registration

The Anthropic client (httpx.AsyncClient) is constructed and returned from _build_retrying_anthropic_model as part of a tuple, then stored in a local variable and torn down in a finally block, with no abstraction for lifecycle ownership

pydantic-ai's infer_model hook accepts a provider_factory callable matching (str) -> Provider signature, but rebar cannot pass this hook a closeable resource channel, making client teardown impossible for non-inline providers

A ProviderSession object should centralize provider construction via a registry and builder pattern, own _closeables tracking for all constructed clients, and expose provider_factory matching pydantic-ai's contract

Anthropic builder and all teardown logic must move into ProviderSession and its exit handler, while _build_retrying_anthropic_model signature and behavior remain unchanged to preserve existing test imports
The model_override code path must bypass the factory entirely and construct no client, leaving the session with nothing to tear down
